verdict.rationale: First-party docs say plugins connect ChatGPT to work tools and information such as Google Drive and SharePoint, which covers the cloud-drive part. Gmail is a supported event source for scheduled tasks that can triage new email, so the email part is at least implied, and admins can govern plugin access. Missing for 10: any evidence of a calendar connector, explicit docs on searching email content in answers rather than only event triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connector search quality.
